informal_statement: For all real \(\lambda\) and \(R\), the density derivative of \(N\) at \(\lambda\) is \(-(4(R-1/2)^2+1+4R(1-\lambda))\).
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:1370-1379`: Lean proves `HasDerivAt` in the density variable for arbitrary real \(\lambda\) and \(R\). Differentiating the polynomial gives \(-4R^2+4R\cdot \lambda -2\), equal to the completed-square expression displayed by the author.
